scripts.build: npm run build -w @cyberlab/web && tsx scripts/openapi.ts && tsx scripts/pwa.ts
scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.workers.config.ts
scripts.types: wrangler types apps/api/env.d.ts -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface AppEnv --strict-vars false && wrangler types apps/scanner/env.d.ts -c apps/scanner/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface ScannerEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply QUOTAS --local -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
